gumroad._comment: All five fields are written by the product-creation job (.github/workflows/gumroad-pro-product.yml, agent work through the token the owner already pastes at step 6) - never by hand, and never an owner step. productUrl is the public https URL of the Pro product page; productId is Gumroad's public product id, the one the licence check sends; priceCents and currency are the price Gumroad itself reports when the job reads the product back (minor units: 7900 = 79.00); enable and the AT-16 probe compare it with Gumroad's live price. refundPeriodDays is the refund window Gumroad applies to the product (its own policy, or the account's 30-day default it inherits), in whole days, or null while unread or when Gumroad reports no bounded window; the pricing FAQ states it only while the button is ready, and enable and the probe compare it with Gumroad's live period as they compare the price (RULING-2026-09-29-lines (h)). Gumroad adds no tax for a buyer in Israel (it collects none there); a buyer abroad may see VAT/GST added at checkout, before paying. While any of them is empty the Pro button stays disabled and says so, and no price is shown - it never pretends a shop exists. The button is a link; the only request to Gumroad is the licence check from the buyer's browser.

analytics._comment: provider: "none" or "plausible". PostHog moved to its own block below because it is configured cookieless.

posthog._comment: Optional page-view measurement, cookieless. Empty by default: with no projectKey no snippet is emitted and nothing third-party loads. Filling it also needs 'Cookieless server hash mode' enabled in the PostHog project settings - see README. projectId is the numeric id of the same PostHog project; it is not a secret and the page never uses it - the colony's weekly page-view reader (src/revenue/page-views-reader.ts) reads it, unless the POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID variable is set, and reads nothing without the POSTHOG_READ_KEY secret. These are the brand organisation's project (ruling 7.10, research/channel-loop/RULING-2026-10-07-posthog-organisation.md §3); the T1 sub-brand's project lives in its own organisation and its own config, products/chart-explainer/counter.json, never here.
